headlines.title: How Democrats could win the House, how the GOP could hang on, and where to look for a wave
headlines.description: Three 2026 election scenarios that show which party could end up in control of the U.S. House of Representatives.

headlines.title: DOJ demands California counties help identify noncitizen voters
headlines.description: The Department of Justice is warning local election officials in California to cooperate with the administration to identify noncitizens on a list of registered voters or face potential legal action, according to a letter obtained by NBC News.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: Iranian plots to kill U.S. officials in Middle East have reached ‘advanced stages,’ intel memo warns
headlines.description: Iran has increased efforts to target U.S. personnel in the Middle East and other countries, according to a memo sent by the Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday.

headlines.title: The U.S. fertility rate keeps declining, and a legendary journalist prepares to sign off: The news quiz
headlines.description: A wounded soldier is evacuated by a drone, a much-loved TV show is getting the reboot treatment, and a Canadian province votes to remain.

headlines.title: Mass protests challenge Macron as French police use tear gas and water cannons
headlines.description: PARIS — More than 100,000 people marched in Paris on Saturday over school funding and soaring living costs, challenging President Emmanuel Macron’s government as police fired tear gas and water cannons near the end of the protest.

headlines.title: U.K. police received claims about Meghan’s father in 2019 but didn’t alert other forces
headlines.description: LONDON — Police in the British capital said Saturday that they received a letter containing allegations about the estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, in 2019, but did not tell other law enforcement agencies.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Six Flags to add seat belts to roller coaster after Georgia man falls to his death
headlines.description: Six Flags said Friday that it will add seat belts to a roller coaster from which a man was ejected and fell to his death earlier this month.

headlines.title: ‘An unfortunate mistake’: Knicks admit error in using championship rings as phishing bait
headlines.description: The New York Knicks’ parent company says it is giving out more than $3.7 million worth of championship rings and jewelry after acknowledging an “unfortunate mistake” of using an offer of free rings to lure employees into a cybersecurity test. As first reported by The Athletic, the email said employees were eligible for a free Knicks championship ring.

headlines.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders take legal action against My Chemical Romance over onstage costumes
headlines.description: The parent company of the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders is taking legal action against My Chemical Romance after the band performed alongside dancers in costumes resembling the iconic cheerleading team’s uniforms this week.
